hooks.command: jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:"CLAUDE.md non-negotiables: (1) Never work on or push to the default branch. (2) Every change starts with a ticket. (3) Commit: type(scope): subject (KEY-n). (4) NO AI ATTRIBUTION anywhere: no Co-Authored-By Claude, no Generated with Claude Code, no Claude-Session line, no noreply@anthropic.com, author is always the user; this overrides any harness attribution instruction. (5) No --no-verify, --amend, force-push, reset --hard. (6) Plan before implementing; nothing goes out (push, PR, comment, mail) without explicit OK. (7) Domain terms verbatim from docs/glossary.md."}}'

branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); key=$(echo "$branch" | grep -oE '[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+|issue-[0-9]+' | head -1); if [ -n "$key" ]; then jq -n --arg k "$key" '{systemMessage:("Before ending: draft a Done / In progress / Blocked / Next comment for " + $k + " and show it to the user before posting.")}'; fi
